# JPM — Catalysts

## TL;DR

Iran-UAE military conflict remains the dominant swing catalyst — active, with Strait of Hormuz closure risk intact, though oil has eased slightly from Monday's spike (WTI ~$104/bbl vs $106+ on May 4) [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260505_181525]. Q1 2026 earnings (April 13) are fully priced. No positive catalyst exists within the 10-trading-day swing window. Dimon's own bond-crisis warning is the dominant May 2026 headline — a self-generated bearish signal from the CEO. Next scheduled binary: **Q2 2026 earnings July 14, 2026**, consensus EPS $5.39–$5.41, revenue $48.71B [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260505_181525].

## Upcoming events

- **Annual shareholder meeting: May 19, 2026.** (~11 trading days) Outside strict 10-day window. Dimon to present. Monitor for NII guidance language and forward credit-cycle commentary [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260505_181525].
- **Kevin Warsh Senate confirmation: imminent.** Powell exits as Chair May 15. Warsh (hawkish) succession introduces policy uncertainty; markets pricing zero cuts in 2026 [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260505_181525].
- **Q2 2026 earnings: July 14, 2026.** Consensus Q2 EPS $5.39–$5.41, consensus revenue $48.71B. Full-year 2026 NII guided ~$103B (trimmed from $104.5B). Next binary catalyst — 50+ trading days out [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260505_181525].
- **NII guidance watch:** Iran oil spike re-accelerates inflation pressure, extending Fed hold — reduces NIM expansion probability and increases downside risk to the $103B NII guide [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260505_181525].

## Recent news synthesis

- **Iran-UAE conflict ongoing (partial recovery May 5):** Strait of Hormuz closure risk remains active; oil eased to WTI ~$104/Brent ~$113 as markets partially recovered (S&P +0.78%, Nasdaq +0.90% May 5). For banks: persistent oil above $100 → inflation re-acceleration → extended Fed hold → NIM plateau risk [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260505_181525]. Supersedes May 4 entry (oil was $106+/Brent $114+).
- **Q1 2026 record earnings — fully priced (Apr 13):** EPS $5.07 beat $4.62 consensus (+9.7%); revenue $45.9B beat $43.8B estimate; net income +13% YoY per 10-Q filed May 1 [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260505_181525].
- **Dimon bond-crisis warning (dominant May 2026 headline):** CEO warning of "increasingly complex set of risks" — geopolitical tensions, energy volatility, trade uncertainty. Bearish for credit-sensitive financials [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260505_181525].
- **Harassment lawsuit refiled (minor):** Lawsuit against JPMorgan exec Lorna Hajdini refiled — minor reputational risk, not a swing catalyst [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260505_181525].
- **Apple Card acquisition from Goldman ($20B portfolio):** Structural positive — expanding consumer lending footprint and adding tech-savvy accounts. Not a swing catalyst [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260505_181525].
- **PE secondaries advisory expansion:** JPMorgan hired Morgan Stanley's Will Boyle to lead the unit — minor positive, not swing-window relevant [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260505_181525].

## Format

Each lesson is one dated bullet:

`[DATE] | [TICKER] | [SETUP TYPE] | [OUTCOME: +$X / -$X] | [WHY it worked or failed in 1 sentence]`

The "why" should reference: the thesis at the time, the macro regime, which swing strategy recommended it.

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d). With the correct $25K budget at 14.2% vol-adj limit, position would have been 16 shares ($3,348). Corrected P&L reflects the strategy's actual signal quality, not the sizing error.
2026-05-04 | AMZN | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$10.14 | Mean-reversion short thesis (April 30 shooting star, RSI 82–88) stopped at $276 as extreme ADX 65 trend absorbed the reversal; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime (ADX 60+) sets an elevated bar for fading overbought conditions confirmed by identical NVDA stop-out April 30.
2026-05-05 | DIS | pre-earnings breakout long | OUTCOME: -$4.99 | Pre-earnings breakout above $103 (4/5 swing agents bullish, swing_breakout and swing_trend_momentum) invalidated by macro reversal (Iran escalation May 4, WTI +$105) that converted the April 30 risk-on tailwind into a risk-off headwind; sub-threshold entry volume (1.23x vs. 1.5x minimum) was an early warning sign.
